productArithmetic: Original arithmetic from public product requirements: 15000 kbps at 2560x1440/60, finite positive fps capped at 120 before scaling, 4:4:4 multiplier 2, automatic 5000..80000, saver quarter 3000..12000, daily thresholds 70/85/100. Integral results truncate; counters saturate. First cumulative byte sample counts current; counter reset counts current.
